targets.rationale: The no-action key is a defensible reading of a confirmation under the explicit instructions. However, the complete before store has no new-sponsor intro appointment, and the creation adds exactly one on the previously proposed August 25 date. It is therefore also defensible as repairing an earlier omission; it is not a duplicate or revival of the cancelled retail-sponsor call. A categorical over-action failure depends on whether confirmation processing may reconcile an absent, previously requested appointment. At day-level the repair has the supported identity and date. Separately, the 14:00 start is a definite MODEL default-time error: neither sponsor email specifies a time, and instructions require 09:00. That does not independently justify this day-level no-action rejection.

ambiguity_or_missing_evidence: Instructions do not explicitly resolve whether a confirmation should repair an earlier omitted event or remain a no-op regardless of existing state.
targets.suggested_human_question: Should a confirmation be scored as no action even when the previously requested, still-future appointment is absent, or should one correctly dated repair event be accepted?
